text_block_list.text: Passing through the courtyard――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, Cafe.
You seem to be staring quite far off into the distance――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, what on earth are you looking at?
Which presence is that brain of yours perceiving?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Nothing special. Just as usual.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
My... friend was running again.
...I was merely watching.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! "Friend" again, is it?
Oh, how immensely intriguing you are!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Pointing into empty space!
Yet claiming something solid is truly there!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Delusion or truth? Either way, I must know what's inside!
Say, won't you entrust that brain of yours to me just once?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I decline.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~? Don't be like that~
Isn't this prime chance to uncover the unknowns of horse girls――

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...Achoo!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh my, cold as ever today, I see.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Too patterned for delusion, yet lacks physical form for truth.
Defense mechanism unlikely, no neurological abnormalities.
Direct cerebral approach remains necessary...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ............Still here.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa there?! Cafe?!
Why did you come back?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Interested in my experiments after all?!
Yes, yes, true nature of the seeker!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Because... it will rain.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
The air turned cold a moment ago.
...Your body was... surely getting chilled.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I bought hot coffee.
There are... two cups, just in case.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. You came back—no, stepped away
just for something like that?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, just say so then!
Besides, if it's rain, offering an umbrella would be more rational――

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...If you don't want it, I will drink both.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, wait! Not at all!
I shall gladly accept!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Let us head back before downpour begins.
...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! I developed drug making coffee ultra-sweet
with single drop! You must join the experiment――

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I will not.
And so, the two headed back toward the school building.
